newsitem.title: USA: American General files $500 mln shelf.
newsitem.headline: American General files $500 mln shelf.

text.p: American General Hospital Corp filed Wednesday with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission to register a shelf offering of up to $500 million in common shares and warrants to purchase common stock.
Proceeds from the sale will be used for general corporate purposes, which may include repaying oustanding debt, acquiring additional hotels and improving currently owned properties.
The Irving, Texas, real estate investment trust did not name any underwriters in the shelf offering.
